extracted.intended_audience: journalists/media outlets, donors, and the general public (readers of organizational press releases)
extracted.subtask_description: Drafting a nonprofit/organizational press release announcing a response to a controversial decision and launching a fundraising initiative; includes headlines, dateline, quotes, supporting data, human-interest anecdote, and boilerplate. Emphasizes media-facing clarity and a call to action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline / Title
rubrics_metrics.description: “Alarmed and Saddened” by Komen Foundation Succumbing to Political Pressure, Planned Parenthood Launches Fund for Breast Cancer Services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Front-load the core news/position and emotional tone in a single declarative headline that summarizes the organization's response and action. Use quotation marks if quoting a strong phrase from a spokesperson. The headline should make the news obvious (response + launch of fund).

rubrics_metrics.name: Release timing flag
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clear release-status line (e.g., 'For Immediate Release') to tell media when the information is available; use standard phrasing so newsrooms know they can publish immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline and location
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the date and city (dateline) immediately before the lead paragraph to situate the news. Use a short month/day/year and capitalized location followed by an en dash to begin the body copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source line / organizational attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Source   Planned Parenthood Federation of America
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly identify the issuing organization. A source line near the top signals provenance to journalists and readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact ... Planned Parenthood Federation of America media office: 212-261-4433
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List one or more media contacts with phone numbers (and email where appropriate) so reporters can quickly reach spokespeople. Repeat contact details near the end if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph / summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned Parenthood Federation of America today expressed deep disappointment in response to the Susan G. Komen for the Cure Foundation’s decision to stop funding breast cancer prevention, screenings and education at Planned Parenthood health centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with a concise paragraph that states the core news (organizational reaction and key action) so readers immediately understand the purpose of the release. Use present-tense verbs and name the decision/actor being responded to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context / background explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: Anti-choice groups in America have repeatedly threatened the Susan G. Komen for the Cure Foundation for partnering with Planned Parenthood to provide these lifesaving cancer screenings and news articles suggest that the Komen Foundation ultimately succumbed to these pressures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide factual background explaining why the action took place and what led to the announcement. This helps journalists quickly understand the stakes and frames subsequent quotes and actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Named spokesperson quotes
rubrics_metrics.description: “We are alarmed and saddened that the Susan G. Komen for the Cure Foundation appears to have succumbed to political pressure. Our greatest desire is for Komen to reconsider this policy and recommit to the partnership on which so many women count,” said Cecile Richards, president of Planned Parenthood Federation of America.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include one or more attributed quotes from senior leadership to provide an authoritative voice, human tone, and a concise interpretation of the organization's position. Quotes should be short, emotive, and actionable (e.g., a call for reconsideration).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program impact data / statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Over the past five years, Planned Parenthood health centers with Komen program funding have provided nearly 170,000 clinical breast exams ... as well as more than 6,400 mammogram referrals out of 70,000 mammogram referrals. ... Nationwide, Planned Parenthood doctors and nurses provide nearly 750,000 breast cancer screenings annually ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete, recent statistics to substantiate claims about scale and impact. Use absolute numbers and timeframes (e.g., 'over the past five years,' 'annually') so journalists can report specifics and verify claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement of action / fundraising initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure that the Komen Foundation’s decision doesn’t jeopardize any woman’s access to lifesaving screenings and services, Planned Parenthood has launched a Breast Health Emergency Fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state what the organization is doing in response (launching a fund, program, campaign). Describe the purpose of the action and whom it will help; this is the central call-to-action news hook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major gift / donor attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Led by a generous $250,000 gift from Amy and Lee Fikes’ foundation, Planned Parenthood has established a Breast Health Emergency Fund ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a significant donor or gift is central to the announcement, name the donor, amount, and intended use. Include an attributed donor quote when available to explain motivation and encourage others to contribute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-interest testimonial / client story
rubrics_metrics.description: Abigail Sanocki, in Denver, Colorado, is one of the thousands of women who have received critical treatment ... 'In January of 2010 I found a lump ... Without Planned Parenthood, I would still be walking around years later unsure of what was going on inside my body ...'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a succinct personal story or testimonial illustrating real-world consequences and emotional stakes. This humanizes statistics and increases media interest; keep names, locations, and a short timeline to lend credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate organizational background
rubrics_metrics.description: One in five women in America has come to Planned Parenthood at some point in her life. More than 90 percent of Planned Parenthood health care is preventive, including lifesaving cancer screenings, birth control ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: End with a short boilerplate that summarizes the organization's mission, scale, and core services. This gives reporters standard background copy they can reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-of-release marker
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a conventional end marker (e.g., '###') to indicate the press release copy is finished. This prevents accidental inclusion of navigation or webpage elements when reporters copy text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix / full donor statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Amy and Lee Fikes Announce $250,000 Gift to Create Planned Parenthood Breast Health Fund: 'Our family is saddened that the far right has relentlessly and successfully pressured the Susan G. Komen for the Cure Foundation ...'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If additional long-form statements (donor statements, full remarks) are available, include them after the main release as an appendix. Label clearly so media know it's optional/attributable material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication metadata / versioning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a published date (and, if relevant, separate release date) so users know when the release was issued and any subsequent updates. If multiple dates appear (release vs. publish), make their roles clear.
